name: Octogee Status Tools
description: octogee_status — gateway class, credential path, and live token-budget window for this agent's owner.

brokerUrl.description: Base URL of octogee-api/fleet broker. Defaults to FLEET_BROKER_URL, OCTOGEE_API_URL, or in-cluster octogee-api.

tokenPath.description: Path to the projected gateway service-account token.

gatewayClass.description: This pod's gateway class (shared|builder), from GATEWAY_CLASS.
